categories.main_business_segments: Hefei Hengxin Life Science and Technology Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, production, and sales of paper and plastic dining utensils. Its main products include biodegradable dining ware made from materials like PLA, PHA, PBAT, and PBS, as well as traditional plastic products such as PE, PET, and PP dining utensils. The company serves sectors including catering, large enterprises and institutions, civil aviation, and household consumption.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced technologies including PLA particle modification, lamination, sheet preparation, and molding techniques for biodegradable products. It has over 60 patents in biodegradable materials and participates in national standards formulation. Production methods cover full-process capabilities from raw material modification to printing and forming, enabling customized and large-scale manufacturing with quality control certifications like BRC, FDA, LFGB, ISO9001, ISO14001, ISO45001, SEDEX, DIN, and BPI.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading global brands in coffee, tea, and fast food sectors such as Luckin Coffee, Starbucks, Manner Coffee, Heytea, Mixue Bingcheng, Coco Tea, McDonald's, and Burger King. The company targets domestic and international markets, focusing on catering, quick-service restaurants, new-style tea and coffee shops, and e-commerce platforms. The market is driven by China's growing catering industry, expanding tea and coffee consumption, and increasing demand for environmentally friendly disposable dining products.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with multiple production bases covering major domestic markets. It has expanded globally with a new production facility in Thailand, marking the start of its international manufacturing and sales layout. The company’s products are sold both domestically and exported internationally, with 61.91% of revenue from domestic sales and 38.09% from exports in 2024.
categories.supply_chain_position: Hefei Hengxin Life Science and Technology operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain. It controls the full production process from raw material modification to finished product manufacturing and sales, serving as a manufacturer and supplier of biodegradable and traditional dining utensils to end customers and brands.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation in biodegradable materials and smart manufacturing, focusing on improving PLA particle modification, lamination, and sheet preparation technologies. It actively researches new biodegradable materials like PHA, PBAT, and PBS, and develops new products such as compostable packaging and high-performance containers. Strategic priorities include global capacity expansion, especially in Thailand, enhancing R&D capabilities, deepening customer relationships, brand building with a focus on sustainability, and advancing intelligent production and information management systems.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through direct sales of customized paper and plastic dining utensils to corporate clients and brands. The company operates a direct sales model, fulfilling orders based on customer specifications. Revenue streams include sales of biodegradable products, traditional plastic products, and other related business activities.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading high-tech enterprise in the biodegradable plastics and dining ware industry in China, recognized as one of the top ten enterprises in the light industry plastics sector for biodegradable plastics. It competes in a fragmented market with low entry barriers, where it differentiates through technology, scale, and comprehensive supply chain capabilities. It holds a strong market position with stable relationships with major global brands and continuous innovation.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.59 billion, an 11.86% increase from 2023, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 220 million, up 2.82%. Total assets reached nearly RMB 2 billion, growing 26.21% year-over-year. The company has shown steady growth in revenue, profitability, and cash flow, supported by expanding production capacity and global market development.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Hefei Hengxin Life Science and Technology offers environmentally friendly, high-quality biodegradable dining products that align with global carbon neutrality and plastic restriction policies. Its comprehensive technology portfolio, extensive patent holdings, and ability to customize products for major international brands provide competitive differentiation. The company emphasizes sustainable innovation, product performance, and compliance with international certifications, delivering value through green, low-carbon solutions that meet evolving market and regulatory demands.
